name: Portal Out
tagline: A glowing portal tears open and you step through.
subject: the person
motion: A swirling ring of violet light tears open in the air beside {subject}, crackling with energy and casting purple light across the scene. {subject} glances at the camera, then steps into the portal and vanishes as it snaps shut with a flash, leaving drifting sparks. Steady camera.
sound: a humming energy vortex, electric crackles, and a sharp collapsing whoomp
author: Conjure
